relationship: former colleague and mentor — warm-professional, respectful; formal 您 in Chinese
subject: 新年快乐, Mei
occasion: 新年快乐 · Happy Lunar New Year
body: Every new year I think about the people who shaped how I lead, and you're always near the top of that list.
I still run my 1:1s the way you taught me: listen first, fix second. It has quietly made me a better manager for years.
I'd love to hear what you're working on these days and how the year is starting for you. No need for a long reply.
closing: 祝您新年快乐，万事如意。
